# Hash-pinned uv for every workflow's "Install uv" step. Installed with
# `python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --require-hashes -r .github/requirements/uv.txt`.
# One hash per platform wheel pip can pick on a GitHub-hosted runner; pip accepts
# whichever one matches the runner. Update by hand alongside UV_VERSION when uv is bumped.
